title: workflow 與 agent 的差別

bullets.text: Workflow 是預先寫好程式路徑，LLM 與工具照順序被編排。
bullets.quote: Workflows are systems where LLMs and tools are orchestrated through predefined code paths.

bullets.text: Agent 則是 LLM 動態決定自己的流程與工具使用。
bullets.quote: Agents, on the other hand, are systems where LLMs dynamically direct their own processes and tool usage, maintaining control over how they accomplish tasks.

bullets.text: 定義清楚的任務適合 workflow，需要彈性時才適合 agent。
bullets.quote: When more complexity is warranted, workflows offer predictability and consistency for well-defined tasks, whereas agents are the better option when flexibility and model-driven decision-making are needed at scale.
